svg.title: OLED — Status Screen
svg.desc: Branded RoboLore instructional graphic showing the Zumo 32U4 OLED status screen on a bronze-framed OLED module. The bronze OLED module image is embedded as a PNG under a single xlink:href, and the sample status text, callouts, and footer remain editable SVG text.
svg.text: • The heading identifies the current screen.
• The uptime value grows while the robot stays powered on.
• Button C shows this screen in the lesson example.
Press Button C to show this screen — uptime increases the longer the robot has been on
